top_signals.title: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading
top_signals.summary: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, with access to its website and app set to be blocked from Dec. 5.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
top_signals.summary: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.

top_signals.title: OpenSSH flaw lets attackers log into password-disabled Linux accounts
top_signals.summary: A newly disclosed OpenSSH vulnerability dubbed "*sshole" allows attackers to log in to certain Alpine Linux and other musl-based Linux accounts that are configured to block password authentication, simply by entering an oversized password. [...]
